name: Mid Missouri Tool & Plastics
old_description: World-Class Production of Injection Molds For The Plastics Industry
about:
Mid Missouri Tool & Plastics operates from Carrollton, Missouri. The company's founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed. It began as a tool and die shop serving the plastics industry.

The company designs and builds injection molds and provides plastic injection molding services, including displacement intrusion molding, insert molding, and overmolding. It works with a range of thermoplastic resins and offers assembly services. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

Its customers include major automotive OEMs, with parts used in applications such as automotive acoustics baffles. The company serves the broader plastics industry but does not list other specific sectors.

The company emphasizes reduced assembly costs and improved part performance as outcomes of its molding technologies. No explicit founding mission or differentiation statement is provided.
type_evidence: MMTP is an experienced tool and die shop. We offer high quality solutions for all your production needs.
